MOD = 998244353

def compute_score_operations(n, array):
    """
    Calculate the sum of Scores over all N! possible permutations of the given array.
    """
    from itertools import combinations
    scores = 0
    for comb in combinations(range(n), enumerate(array).index(n)):
        scores += sum([element ^ bigos[sorted(comb)[i]] for i, element in enumerate(array)])
        scores %= MOD
    return scores

        array = list(map(int, input().strip().split()))
